```go
import "example.com/widgets/lib/gadget"
```

Package gadget holds widgets.

## Functions

### Size

```go
func Size() int
```

Size names [widget.Fast](/docs/reference/go-api/widget/#slow), a constant of a group, and [widget.Widget.Name](/docs/reference/go-api/widget/#widget), a field, and [widget.Missing](https://pkg.go.dev/example.com/widgets/lib/widget#Missing), which nothing documents.

## Types

### Gadget

```go
type Gadget struct{}
```

Gadget holds a [widget.Widget](/docs/reference/go-api/widget/#widget); see [widget](/docs/reference/go-api/widget/) and [errors.New](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#New).
